R4E-duck-walk-0002.name: Unnamed lake 150 m E of Columbia River
R4E-duck-walk-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Unnamed lake, 18.8 ha, 380 m from the road.
About 19 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Columbia River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 784 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-35, Region 4 Kootenay. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-01): get permission first or go around.
Private land 220 m NE: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Hwy 95 380 m NE: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

Inside COLUMBIA WETLANDS WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT AREA Wildlife Management Area: rules differ by area. Call the regional office before you hunt (synopsis page 9, 99%). No conveyance with a motor over 10 hp, except boats on navigable parts of the Columbia River; no electric or gas boats in the wetlands (synopsis pages 38 and 41, Map D21, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 4. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Village of Radium Hot Springs, about 104 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 95.
Park: 51.16782, -116.82189, pull off on Hwy 95 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 380 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-35, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.

R4E-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Malachite Creek
R4E-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
7 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
30 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
